Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Interface FileSystem

All Known Implementing Classes:
AzureBlobFileSystem, GcsFileSystem, GridFsFileSystem, LocalFileSystem, S3FileSystem
public interface FileSystem
A navigable file system backing one pane of the DualPaneBrowser — either the local disk (LocalFileSystem) or a remote service (SFTP/FTP). Implementations do the blocking I/O; the browser pane always calls these off the JavaFX thread.

    • diskSpace

      default Optional<DiskSpace> diskSpace(String path)
      Free/total capacity of the volume backing path, for the pane's status line. Empty by default (remote services that can't report it); LocalFileSystem answers from the disk. Called off the FX thread alongside list(java.lang.String), so an implementation may do blocking I/O.

    • supportsCopy

      default boolean supportsCopy()
      True if this file system can duplicate an entry in place (the "Duplicate" action). Defaults to whatever content access allows — a file can be duplicated by reading and re-writing its bytes — so any FS with supportsContentAccess() gets file duplication for free; LocalFileSystem overrides to also copy directory trees.

    • copy

      default void copy(FileItem src, String destDir, String destName) throws Exception
      Copies file src to a new entry named destName in directory destDir. The default handles a single file via readFile(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem, long)/writeFile(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, byte[]); directory copies require an override (see LocalFileSystem).
      Throws:
      Exception

    • supportsChecksum

      default boolean supportsChecksum()
      True if this file system can compute a content checksum for a file, letting TransferQueue verify a transfer by digest rather than by size alone. Defaults to whatever content access allows — a file's bytes can be read back and hashed — so any FS with supportsContentAccess() gets checksums for free; LocalFileSystem overrides checksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem) to stream instead.

    • canChecksum

      default boolean canChecksum(FileItem item)
      True if this file system can hash this particular file. Narrower than supportsChecksum(): the default checksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem) buffers the whole file into a byte[], so anything larger than MAX_IN_MEMORY_CHECKSUM_BYTES would come back silently truncated and hash to a digest that wrongly looks like corruption — such a file reports false here instead, and the caller falls back to a size check. An implementation that streams (LocalFileSystem) or reads a stored digest overrides this to drop the size limit.

    • checksum

      default String checksum(FileItem item) throws Exception
      The Checksum.ALGORITHM digest of item's content, as hex. The default reads the whole file into memory via readFile(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem, long); an implementation that can stream (or that already knows a digest, e.g. from object-store metadata) should override, along with canChecksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem). Callers should consult canChecksum(com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileItem) first — this throws for a file it cannot faithfully hash rather than returning a digest of a truncated read.
      Throws:
      Exception

    • supportsChmod

      default boolean supportsChmod()
